---
title: "Colores con nombre"
lang: es
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: note
---

Words take a colour by name: the built-in [ok]{.ok}, [ko]{.ko} and
[muted]{.muted}, beside the brand's [accent]{.accent}. Each prints in its
colour in the PDF, the .docx, the .pptx and the .epub; none is defined in the
preamble, so a document without them keeps its .tex byte for byte.

| Partida              | Importe | Bloque              |
|:---------------------|--------:|:--------------------|
| Licencias anuales    |  12 400 | **[Verde]{.ok}**    |
| Viajes sin aprobar   |   3 150 | **[Rojo]{.ko}**     |
| Formación pendiente  |   1 800 | **[Gris]{.muted}**  |

A class far from every colour's name, [versalitas]{.smallcaps}, is pandoc's
own and stays as it was.
